235K+ annually. Housing at 8x income. Near-zero vacancy. Financialization creates the crisis. MAID offered to those it destroys.
Indigenous overrepresentation. Jordan's Principle violated. 1 in 4 food insecure. Cannot vote, file ATIPs, or advocate. The most voiceless victims.
TRC 94 Calls incomplete. MMIWG 231 unimplemented. 28+ boil water advisories. The foundational failure that defines the Canadian state.
7% health budget (OECD: 12%+). Months-long waits. MAID mental illness expansion delayed because system "isn't ready." The gap IS the pipeline.
22 deaths/day. Health Canada approved. PMPRB didn't control prices. Purdue settled. The parallel death pipeline: toxic supply instead of lethal injection.
Canada Disability Benefit: $200/month vs $22K poverty line. MAID offered when disability makes life "irremediable." The benefit-to-death pipeline.
$2T+ pension assets invested in the system. Your retirement depends on rising housing prices and healthcare privatization. Reform threatens your savings.
Veterans. Immigrants. Elderly. Homeless. Children. Indigenous. Mentally ill. Opioid victims. Disabled. And through pension capture — every Canadian .

The 13-layer architecture produces harm across every population. The 8-dimension sovereignty failure ensures the nation cannot protect its people. The 10 oversight bodies cannot enforce. And the complete thesis shows why the system is designed to resist reform.
